types.name: NotificationType1EnumValues
types.description:
This enum categorises the different types of messages that can be generated within the system. It is used for the classification of messages in order to simplify the decision for the API consumer as to how to proceed with the respective message. This enum is used in numerous business objects, including addresses, payments, natural persons, organisations and relationships.

@since 5.2021
buf:lint:ignore ENUM_VALUE_PREFIX
buf:lint:ignore ENUM_ZERO_VALUE_SUFFIX

source: ALQE_MELDUNGSTYP_1 VARCHAR2(20)

 - NOTIFICATION_TYPE1_UNSPECIFIED: Unspecified
 - NOTIFICATION_TYPE1_INFO: Denotes messages that are purely informative and do not require any immediate action. These messages are only intended to notify the user of a particular state or process in the system.

source: INFO
 - NOTIFICATION_TYPE1_WARNING: Marks warnings that indicate potential problems or unusual situations that may require attention. The process may continue despite these warnings, but it is recommended to take the warning into account.

source: WARNUNG
 - NOTIFICATION_TYPE1_ERROR: Identifies error messages that indicate serious problems that prevent the successful completion of an operation. In the event of errors, correction or intervention is usually required before the process can be continued.

source: FEHLER
 - NOTIFICATION_TYPE1_CONFIRMATION: Designates confirmation messages that provide positive feedback about a successfully completed procedure. These messages confirm to the user that a requested action was performed as expected.

source: BESTAETIGUNG
 - NOTIFICATION_TYPE1_VALIDATION: Indicates validation messages that relate to the validation of data or inputs. These messages provide information about the result of a validation process and may indicate any necessary adjustments.

source: VALIDIERUNG

services.name: PostCreateMultipleNaturalPerson4
services.description:
Creates a client as a two-person master record.

Error handling:
This method may return the following gRPC error codes with additional error details:

- INVALID_ARGUMENT
  * common.finnova.com.ClientCommunicationTypeLimitExceeded:
    When creating a two-person master record, multiple communication entries of the same type cannot be entered for the specified communication type.
    Inserting would result in multiple communication entries with the same CommunicationData1.communicationTypeCode, which is not permitted. Each communication type may only occur once in the CreateMultipleNaturalPerson4.communicatonData collection.
  * common.finnova.com.ClientForeignPhoneNumberNotAllowed:
    A foreign telephone number is not allowed for the specified communication method.
    According to the program parameter, a foreign telephone number is not permitted for the specified CommunicationData1.communicationTypeCode. The parameter CommunicationType1.isForeignPhoneNumberPermitted needs to be activated in order to use foreign telephone numbers for this type of communication.
  * common.finnova.com.ClientOnlyOneRelevantCommEntryPerTypeAllowedError:
    Only one communication entry marked as relevant per type is permitted.
    Only one communication entry marked as relevant is permitted. The field CommunicationData1.isRelevantEntry may only be set to 'true' in case of a single entry in the CreateMultipleNaturalPerson4.communicatonDatacollection.
  * common.finnova.com.ClientPhoneNumberInvalidFormat:
    The formatting of the telephone number is invalid.
    The formatting of the telephone number in the field CommunicationData1.numberOrAddress does not correspond to the defined formatting rules. Correct formatting has been defined depending on the country code in the fields Country1.exampleTelNumber1 and Country1.exampleTelNumber2 of the lookup view.
  * common.finnova.com.ValidationFailed:
